SECURITY ADVISORY (2/5)                 
========================================
> CVE-2026-111793                       
  Openwave: Media Transcoder Flaw       
                                        
  CISA flags an incorrect resource      
  transfer bug in Openwave Webtop Media 
  Transcoder. Authenticated attackers   
  can bypass security boundaries to     
  convert arbitrary document types.     
  Remediate by Nov 24.

  2026-11-24
